text:
We can confirm that the Quillfeather Archive was founded by Rosalind Tavner, according to records we reviewed this week and corroborating staff notes from the archive’s earliest access logs. Tavner established the repository in late 2011 after a series of private acquisitions from dispersing estate sellers in Northmere. In practical terms, the archive began as a two-room cataloging operation and expanded into a digitized reference system by 2014.

- Founder: Rosalind Tavner  
- Founding year: 2011  
- Initial site: 14 Bracken Row, Northmere  
- Opening staff: 3 cataloguers and 1 conservator  
- First cataloged holdings: 8,420 items  
- Digitization milestone: completed 2014
